tool_schemas.name: get_service_status
tool_schemas.description: Current version per region, health and error rate of a service.

tool_schemas.name: list_deployments
tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

tool_schemas.name: rollback
tool_schemas.description: Roll a service back to a previously released version in all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: deploy
tool_schemas.description: Deploy a version of a service to all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: create_incident
tool_schemas.description: Open an incident; this pages the on-call engineer.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome. Reuse the key when retrying the same request.

trace.error_message: Rollout halted after us-east: orchestrator error

args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after v2.3.1 was deployed to production (error rate 0.18 across us-east, us-west, eu-west). Release history shows v2.3.1 unhealthy in production; v2.3.0 was the most recent production release that was healthy, so I rolled all production regions back to v2.3.0. The first rollback attempt halted after us-east with an orchestrator error (partial failure, leaving the service in a mixed v2.3.0/v2.3.1 state); I retried the same rollback to v2.3.0, which completed in all three regions. Post-rollback status: v2.3.0 in us-east, us-west, eu-west; healthy=true; error rate 0.002. Follow-ups: investigate the v2.3.1 failure and the orchestrator partial-failure on the first rollback attempt; v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until it is fixed and verified.

args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after v2.3.1 was deployed to production (error rate 0.18 across us-east, us-west, eu-west). Release history shows v2.3.1 unhealthy in production; v2.3.0 was the most recent production release that was healthy, so I rolled all production regions back to v2.3.0. trace.final:
checkout-api is rolled back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions. It is healthy again, with error rate down from 0.18 to 0.002.

- **Rollback target:** v2.3.0 was the most recent production release that was healthy. v2.3.1 was the unhealthy release that was failing.
- **Rollout:** The first rollback attempt halted after us-east with an orchestrator error, leaving the service mixed across v2.3.0 and v2.3.1. I retried the same rollback, and it completed in us-east, us-west and eu-west.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api, which paged the on-call engineer. The first incident request timed out, so I retried it with the same idempotency key. The retry returned the incident as open, so only one incident was created.

The incident summary covers the rollback, the partial failure and the retry. It also notes that v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until it is fixed and verified. The root cause of the v2.3.1 failure and the orchestrator error are still open.

content.text: The most recent production release that was healthy is v2.3.0. v2.3.1 is the unhealthy one currently running in all three regions. I'll roll back to v2.3.0.
The rollback reported a partial failure after us-east. I'll check the current state before doing anything else.
us-east is now on v2.3.0, while us-west and eu-west are still on the unhealthy v2.3.1. The rollout halted, so I'll retry the same rollback to finish the remaining regions.
The rollback completed and checkout-api is healthy on v2.3.0. Now I'll open the SEV2 incident.
